items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated remote attackers to switch customer sessions and escalate privileges. Exploitation attempts have been observed in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin addresses multiple critical, high, medium, and low severity vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover, stored cross-site scripting, and incorrect authorization issues.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability (CVSS 7.7) could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce B2B leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.6) in Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.5) could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including issues that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Some critical authorization failures require no authentication.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) enabling Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A critical stored Cross-site Scripting vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) could enable arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Path Traversal vulnerability allowing Arbitrary File System Writes
items.summary: A critical Path Traversal vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) allows arbitrary file system writes.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin addresses multiple critical, high, and medium vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, arbitrary file system write, application denial-of-service, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.5) could lead to a security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.5) could lead to a security feature bypass, allowing unauthenticated attackers to gain unauthorized write access.

items.title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) enabling Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability (CVSS 7.4) could enable a security feature bypass.

items.title: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption leading to Application Denial-of-Service
items.summary: Multiple high-severity uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerabilities (CVSS 7.5 each) could cause application denial-of-service.

items.title: Unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce REST API
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store by disguising code as an image. Adobe released Magento 2.4.9 with a fix by May 12, 2026, but older supported release lines remain vulnerable.
